evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Framing a known production failure as something to reproduce carries low-arousal negative valence — matter-of-fact engagement with a defect, not alarm or frustration.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Imperative 'must' clauses repeated in tight succession register urgency-as-demand — elevated arousal directed at preventing a negative outcome.
